name: Dom
houseDescription: Exercise gear, bold colors, and open floor space — a loft that doubles as a friendly training studio.
description: Workout-motivated sheep with pure sunshine energy. Dom is earnest, loud about fitness, and beloved on wholesome, active islands.

seo.title: Dom — Jock sheep
seo.description: Workout-motivated sheep with pure sunshine energy. Dom is earnest, loud about fitness, and beloved on wholesome, active islands.

acnh.appearance: Dom is a cream-wool sheep with coral-pink skin, white hooves, and horns striped in pale crimson and pink. Large black eyes hold twin white glints, and his mouth curves like a tiny numeral three — earnest, bright, impossible to miss on the plaza.
acnh.personality: Dom burns with jock enthusiasm — fitness, sports, and friendly brags about reps and runs. He compliments effort and may nudge the player about workouts with a grin, not malice, commenting on stamina the way others comment on weather. Peppy and smug villagers match his energy; snooty neighbors bristle at fitness critiques, and cranky villagers tire of his hype and loud optimism. While often friendly, his hyper personality can grate on quieter types until they learn he means well. He sleeps around half past midnight and rises at half past six, already stretching for the day with tie-dye confidence and sheepish charm.

villagerInfo.quote: Be true to your most shiny self.
